item.tib: byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa
item.skt: bo d++hi sat+wa tsar+ya a ba tA ra
item.coloph: byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa slob dpon shan+ta de bas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dz+nyA de ba dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba ban+de dpal brtsegs kyi kha che'i dpe la gtugs te gtan la phab pa las/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po d+harma shrI b+ha dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba rin chen bzang po dang / shAkya blo gros kyis yul dbus kyi dpe dang 'grel pa dang mthun par bcos shing bsgyur te gtan la phab pa/ yang slad kyi bal po'i paN+Di ta su ma ti kIrti dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis dag par bcos shing zhus te/ legs par gtan la phab pa'o
